active_constraints_at_280kg_optimum.status: ACTIVE (optimal 3.454 kWh net with 29.9% regen at P_cap=38.5 kW, v_max=18.4 m/s)
active_constraints_at_280kg_optimum.impact: Directly trades Endurance pace vs FSG Efficiency score; hard ceiling on average power.

hard_hardware_wall_requiring_redesign: Motor copper resistance R(T) & AMK/in-wheel stator cooling: even at 45 C, 10-15 kW is lost in I^2*R(T)+FW under 80 kW DC; recovering >3 kW more requires higher-voltage/lower-R windings or higher-efficiency SiC inverters.
Aerodynamic downforce-to-drag ceiling (CFD ClA=4.68, CdA=1.50): further cornering speed requires a redesigned high-efficiency undertray/wing package (higher ClA/CdA).
Decoupled heave-roll suspension hardware: standard pushrod cannot decouple pitch/heave aero platform control from roll compliance without adding ~1.2-2.0 kg hardware.
Vehicle total mass below 280 kg: further mass reduction (<270 kg) requires structural monocoque/battery-pack/unsprung upright redesign.
